hooks.command: bash -c 'cmd="$1"; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE "(rm -rf|git push --force|git reset --hard|DROP TABLE|DELETE FROM [a-z]+ WHERE|kubectl delete)"; then echo "BLOCKED: destructive command detected: $cmd" >&2; exit 1; fi' -- "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"

bash -c 'path="$1"; if echo "$path" | grep -qE "(\.env$|\.env\.local$|\.env\.production$|secrets\.|credentials\.)"; then echo "BLOCKED: writing to secret file: $path" >&2; exit 1; fi' -- "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"

bash -c 'path="$1"; if echo "$path" | grep -qE "\.(kt|java)$"; then cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && module=$(echo "$path" | grep -oE "backend/(api|worker)") && if [ -n "$module" ]; then (cd "$module" && ./gradlew ktlintCheck -q 2>&1 | head -20) || true; fi; fi' -- "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
